name: Dr. Kamna Chhibber
about: Dr. Kamna Chhibber is a trained therapist specializing in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), relationship counseling, and depression management.

name: Dr. Sameer Malhotra
about: Dr. Sameer Malhotra provides comprehensive mental health care, focusing on stress management, anxiety, OCD, and adult behavioral disorders.

name: Dr. Roma Kumar
about: Dr. Roma Kumar is a highly experienced psychologist dealing with child, adolescent, and adult behavioral issues, as well as family counseling.

name: Dr. Vipul Rastogi
about: Specializes in treating bipolar disorder, adult ADHD, and severe anxiety using evidence-based therapeutic approaches and mindfulness techniques.

name: Dr. Nimesh G. Desai
clinic: IHBAS (Institute of Human Behaviour and Allied Sciences)
about: Former Director of IHBAS, Dr. Desai is a veteran in public mental health, dealing with complex psychiatric conditions and providing accessible therapy.

name: Dr. Mimansa Singh Tanwar
about: Expert in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy and adolescent mental health, focusing on screen addiction, self-esteem issues, and mood disorders.
